{{Lua|Module:List}}
{{Uses TemplateStyles|Template:Image key/styles.css}}

The '''image key''' template is intended to help create lists of keys in images. These keys will display in 2 columns. The syntax is trivial: just add the list using the same syntax as [[Template:Unbulleted list]]!

== Use ==
Note: This template may be used only within the caption parameter of an image. It won't work in a caption parameter of an infobox.
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{image key
|list type=
|
|
|
...
}}</syntaxhighlight>

Prefer the redirect {{tl|legend-col}} when this template is being used to support the use of {{tl|legend}}.

== Parameters ==
; {{para|list type}}
: Defines a list type for the template. Can be one of the values {{kbd|ordered}}, {{kbd|bulleted}}, {{kbd|unbulleted}} (synonym {{kbd|plainlist}}). An ordered list is numbered, bulleted are basic lists, and unbulleted display nothing (i.e., are "plain lists").
; {{para|<N>}}
: A list item. If there is an equal sign in the list item, add it as the numbered item e.g. {{para|1|list item with equals sign}}.
; {{para|thumb size}}
: Optional.
: {{para|thumb size|wide}} Adds a 3rd column. Use only for "wide" images.
: {{para|thumb size|narrow}} Removes one column to display 1 column only. Use only for "narrow" images.

Most thumbnails these days use {{para|upright}}, so these are qualitative rather than quantitative directions for use of {{para|wide}} and {{para|narrow}}.

== Examples ==
=== Unordered list ===

{{legend-col
|{{legend|#e0e0e0|No data}}
|{{legend|#cccccc|No minimum wage}}
|{{legend|#d0d1e6|$0.00–$1.00}}
|{{legend|#a6bddb|$1.01–$2.00}}
|{{legend|#74a9cf|$2.01–$3.00}}
|{{legend|#3690c0|$3.01–$5.00}}
|{{legend|#0570b0|$5.01–$7.50}}
|{{legend|#045a8d|$7.51–$10.00}}
|{{legend|#023858|>$10.00}}
}}]]
